label: Diagram 1.1
caption: Diagram 1.1 | Measuring rise and going
description:
Diagram 1.1, titled "Measuring rise and going," consists of two parts, a. and b. Part a. is labelled "DWELLINGS" and shows two side-on profile views of stairs. The first view depicts an "Open riser" where the "Top surface of tread" extends over the step below; a note states "Open riser treads should overlap at least 16mm." The second view shows a standard stair profile. Dimension lines indicate "Going" is measured "from nosing to nosing," "Rise" is the vertical height between steps, and "Pitch" is the angle of the stair.

Part b. is labelled "BUILDINGS OTHER THAN DWELLINGS" and shows four examples of tread profiles. These profiles illustrate that "Treads should overlap no more than 25mm," with a specific callout for "Max 25mm overlap." Similar to part a., dimension lines identify the "Top surface of tread," "Going" (measured "from nosing to nosing"), "Rise," and "Pitch." Both parts include notes regarding the illustrative nature of the tread profiles.
